runners.name: Dubai Harbour
runners.spotlight: Both wins have come over C&D; losing run up to 14, but is lower in the weights than when placed four times on Polytrack (three here) after returning last October; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner; favourably treated on best Polytrack form during the winter; shortlisted

runners.name: Crazy Plan
runners.spotlight: Stepped up considerably on previous efforts when second of ten on handicap debut at Wolverhampton (1m4f, Tapeta) four weeks ago; a couple of those behind have won since and she remains unexposed, but she has gone up 3lb and not sure the return to a sharper test will suit.
runners.comment: Runner-up at Wolverhampton last time; up 3lb and not sure return to this trip will suit

runners.name: Chico Dulce
runners.spotlight: Polytrack regular who has been kept to 1m since winning over that trip here last November, but he also has winning form over C&D; just 1lb above his last winning mark and high on list with Billy Loughnane aboard for the first time.
runners.comment: C&D winner; just 1lb higher than when last successful; Billy Loughnane a notable booking

runners.name: Arlecchino's Rex
runners.spotlight: Dual winner on the Wolverhampton Tapeta, the latest (9.5f) in March; modest effort in a 0-50 classfied event there (8.6f) eight weeks ago and has a wide draw to overcome; others preferred.
runners.comment: Dual winner on the Wolverhampton Tapeta; modest effort there last time; drawn wide

runners.name: Stacey Racey
runners.spotlight: Twice placed off 2lb higher both here (7f) and at Wolverhampton (8.6f, Tapeta) earlier in year; modest in two starts after returning last month, though, and has never attempted this far before.
runners.comment: Modest in two starts after returning last month and has never attempted this far before

runners.name: Roman Secret
runners.spotlight: Both wins have come on Tapeta at Wolverhampton, the latest on her reappearance (9.5f) in April when trained by Kevin Frost; probably didn't stay on stable debut there (1m4f) four weeks ago but still has enough to prove, especially from the outside stall.
runners.comment: Both wins have come on Tapeta at Wolverhampton; drawn widest and has enough to prove
runners.owner: Dr M Voikhansky & Mrs S Voikhanskaya

runners.name: Shifra
runners.spotlight: Running well over this trip on turf here in her last couple of starts, finishing runner-up in May and going one better under Seamus Cronin the following month; up 5lb, but latest form has been boosted with the second and third both winning twice since; respected if as effective back on Polytrack; stable also runs Dubai Harbour.
runners.comment: Progressive on turf here in last two starts; form of latest win boosted; respected

runners.name: Summer Evening
runners.spotlight: Placed a couple of times in handicaps here (1m/1m2f) earlier in year after the cheekpieces went on, but the novelty seemed to wear off and she is now 0-15; relies on just the tongue-tie today; drawn wide.
runners.comment: 0-15; placed a couple of times here earlier in year, but has regressed since; drawn wide

runners.name: Lady Aiyana
runners.spotlight: Nine-race maiden who made the frame a couple of times for the Kublers last autumn, including over C&D, but with the tongue-tie added there has been little to shout about in three starts since returning for this yard in May.
runners.comment: 0-9; little to shout about in three starts since returning for this yard in May

runners.name: Warriors Choice
runners.spotlight: Unplaced all seven starts, the last three in handicaps with cheekpieces added; opposable up in trip from her wide draw.
runners.comment: Unplaced all seven starts, the last three with cheekpieces added; opposable up in trip

runners.name: Lady Of Chivalry
runners.spotlight: Showed some ability in one start for Andrew Balding last summer, but with a tongue-tie added has shown little in two outings since returning for this yard in May; longer trip should be within range on breeding and worth a market check on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Longer trip should be within range on breeding and worth a market check on handicap debut

runners.name: Little Tiger
runners.spotlight: Dual winner over this trip on turf in 2024 and didn't run at all badly when fourth of 13 at Brighton (1m2f, good) in June after 221 days off; seven previous goes on the AW leave him with something to prove.
runners.comment: Ran well on his reappearance, but seven goes on the AW leave him with something to prove

runners.name: Warrnambool
runners.spotlight: 0-17 and unplaced in his last three starts off this mark; returns to his former trainer after 228 days off; market should be revealing.
runners.comment: 0-17; returns to his former trainer after 228 days off; market should be revealing

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 British EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (Qual') (GBB)

runners.name: Bellatina
runners.spotlight: Runner-up over 5f in three of her first four starts on turf, but didn't seem to take to Bath (5f, firm) last time; relatively exposed and needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: Runner-up three times over 5f on turf, but a lesser effort last time; relatively exposed

runners.name: Desert Sands
runners.spotlight: Performed respectably when midfield in the Albany at Royal Ascot (6f, good to firm; 250-1) in June and although only ninth of 11 at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) last month, she did show some early speed; dam won on the AW and interesting down in trip.
runners.comment: Midfield in the Albany and showed early speed last time; interesting down in trip

runners.name: Ouragan
runners.spotlight: Her second of ten at Newbury (6f, good to firm) last month received a huge boost when the winner landed the Sweet Solera on Saturday, but this filly was a bit disappointing at Wolverhampton (6f, Tapeta) 12 days ago; drop in trip may help.
runners.comment: Runner-up to Saturday's Sweet Solera winner at Newbury last month; drop in trip may help

runners.name: Birkacre Brow
runners.spotlight: Showed some ability when fourth of seven on her Redcar debut (5f, good to firm) in May, but didn't seem to stay at Yarmouth (6f, good to firm) the following month; nicely bred, so may yet do better and the return to this trip should suit.
runners.comment: Nicely bred, so may yet do better and the return to this trip should suit

runners.name: Crimson Blaze
runners.spotlight: Out of the frame in four starts, though she may have been placed before being badly hampered at Bath (5.7f, firm; first start since wind surgery) 11 days ago; a possible if building on that.
runners.comment: May have been placed had she not been hampered last time; a possible if building on that

races.race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Spirit Of Athene
runners.spotlight: Landed a 1m novice here in December and, after being beaten a head on her reappearance/handicap debut at Salisbury (1m2f, good to firm) last month, she overcame a stumble to regain winning form at Sandown (1m2f, good to firm) 18 days later; up another 5lb, but she is on an upward curve and is much respected.
runners.comment: Has won two of her last three starts; up another 5lb, but she is on an upward curve

runners.name: Distant Shore
runners.spotlight: Hooded all starts; dead-heated in her sole outing as a 2yo and has only gone down narrowly in her last two starts, firstly at Sandown (1m, good) and then at Nottingham (1m, good to firm); dam won on the AW and she should stay this far, but she has gone up another 4lb which isn't ideal.
runners.comment: Only just beaten in her last two starts, but has gone up another 4lb which isn't ideal

runners.name: Rastnet
runners.spotlight: Only made her debut last October and has proved consistent on the AW (5221222), the win coming at Wolverhampton (9.5f, Tapeta) in December; return to an artificial surface a positive, but she may need further than this now and could be vulnerable to the 3yos.
runners.comment: Has proved consistent on the AW (5221222), but she may need further than this now

runners.name: Guesstimate
runners.spotlight: Wasn't winning out of turn when making all in a five-runner Nottingham novice (1m2f, good to firm) last month; the third has won since, but this still looks tougher back in a handicap.
runners.comment: Made all in a Nottingham novice last month but this still looks tougher back in a handicap

runners.name: Asset
runners.spotlight: Has proved consistent since returning in May, beating two rivals when off the mark in a Pontefract maiden (1m, good to firm; 2-13) 16 days ago; will need still more now switched to a handicap back on the AW, but a more truly run race over this trip should suit her.
runners.comment: Consistent on turf since returning in May; a truly run race over this trip should suit
runners.owner: Gestuet Schlenderhan Gmbh U Co Kg

runners.name: Deedaydiva
runners.spotlight: Won a Sandown maiden (7f, soft) just under a year ago (form worked out well) and ran well on her reappearance, but only beat one home on handicap debut at Ascot (1m, good) in May; off three months since, but this trip should suit on AW debut.
runners.comment: Off three months since a modest handicap debut, but this trip should suit on AW debut

runners.name: She Commands
runners.spotlight: 2-2 on the AW, the wins coming in novices here (1m) last October and at Wolverhampton (9.5f, Tapeta) in May; finished down the field in the Sandringham at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm) in June, but interesting back on this surface and the longer trip shouldn't be an issue on breeding.
runners.comment: 2-2 on the AW; down the field in the Sandringham, but interesting back on this surface

runners.name: Pomme Pomme
runners.spotlight: Completed a five-timer in the middle of last year including a win at Wolverhampton (6f, Tapeta); still 5lb higher than for her latest success and her efforts since returning in April suggest she needs to drop a bit more in the weights.
runners.comment: Completed a five-timer last year and still 5lb higher than for her latest success

runners.name: Radiance
runners.spotlight: Twice disappointed after her impressive winning debut at Yarmouth (7f, good) in July last year, albeit she returned with a wound on her final outing; interesting to see what the market says about her now making her AW debut after 11 months off.
runners.comment: Interesting to see what the market says about her on AW debut after 11 months off

runners.name: Big Bear Hug
runners.spotlight: Returned to winning form in a slowly run apprentice handicap at Kempton (1m3f, Polytrack) last month and probably didn't stay 1m5f here five days later; new mark has now kicked in and she looks vulnerable to younger legs.
runners.comment: New mark has now kicked in and she looks vulnerable to younger legs

runners.comment: Only just beaten in his last two starts; this trip shouldn't be an issue on a sharp track

runners.name: Dotties Star
runners.spotlight: Narrowly landed a similar event over C&D in March, but well held in three handicaps since; return to this level should help, but others are preferred for the win.
runners.comment: Narrowly landed a similar event over C&D in March; return to this level should help

runners.name: Tiger Beetle
runners.spotlight: All four wins, including three at Wolverhampton, have come at around 1m2f; this trip looks right on the limit of his stamina, but he drops to this level for the first time so is well worth a second look.
runners.comment: Has stamina to prove, but drops to this level for the first time; well worth a second look

runners.name: Dinah Myte
runners.spotlight: Running consistently well in recent months including winning a handicap at Newcastle (1m, Tapeta) in June; yet to attempt this far, but still one for the shortlist down to this level for the first time.
runners.comment: Running consistently well in recent months; one for the shortlist down to this level

runners.name: Fighting Poet
runners.spotlight: All three wins have come at Brighton, the latest a year ago; heavy defeats in his last four starts make him hard to recommend.
runners.comment: Heavy defeats in his last four starts make him hard to recommend

runners.name: Foinix
runners.spotlight: 1-31 on the AW; placed in similar events at Brighton (1m4f, good to firm) in his last two starts, but it's only modest form and likely he will need more to take this.
runners.comment: 1-31 on the AW; placed at Brighton in his last two starts, but it's only modest form
runners.owner: M Robinson, Jack Pook & Jeanette May

runners.name: Wrist Art
runners.spotlight: One of his better efforts when runner-up in an amateurs' event at Windsor (11.4f, good to firm) eight days ago, but is 0-15 on the AW and 2-50 overall; may again find one or two too good.
runners.comment: 0-15 on the AW and 2-50 overall; may again find one or two too good

runners.name: Amalfi Bluebell
runners.spotlight: Hasn't finished within 12l of the winner in six starts including one at this level; hard to make a case for.
runners.comment: Hasn't finished within 12l of the winner in six starts including one at this level

runners.name: Suitcase Smith
runners.spotlight: Unplaced in nine starts and only marginal improvement dropped to this level when fourth of seven at Yarmouth (11.5f, good to firm) last month (third has won since); needs to improve for the new surface.
runners.comment: Unplaced in nine starts; needs to improve for the new surface

runners.name: Crack Of Thunder
runners.spotlight: Beaten a long way in a bumper and three starts over 9.5f-1m4f on the AW; cheekpieces given a go, but still makes no appeal.
runners.comment: Beaten a long way in a bumper and three starts on the AW; cheekpieces on; makes no appeal

runners.name: Dubai Immo
runners.spotlight: All three wins have come in AW handicaps, but recent efforts don't suggest a return to winning form is imminent.
runners.comment: Recent efforts don't suggest a return to winning form is imminent

runners.spotlight: Record on the AW reads 11212; all three wins have come on Tapeta, but he was second of ten here (6f) in April; up 1lb, but still hard to imagine him not being involved.
runners.comment: Record on the AW reads 11212; hard to imagine him not being involved

runners.name: Three Non Blondes
runners.spotlight: 2-4 on the AW for Karl Burke and made it third-time lucky on turf for this yard when narrowly winning a four-runner contest at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) last time; only 1lb higher and should again go well.
runners.comment: 2-4 on the AW and won narrowly on turf last time; only 1lb higher and should again go well

runners.owner: M Robinson, W Trenchard, Mrs R L Field

runners.name: Brisk Symphony
runners.spotlight: Won twice over 6f on turf last summer; 1lb lower than when second of nine over C&D in May, but she has failed to beat a rival in two starts on turf since; something to prove.
runners.comment: 1lb lower than when second over C&D in May, but failed to beat a rival in two starts since

runners.name: Do Bronxs
runners.spotlight: Highly tried following his successful debut at Ayr (6f, good) in June last year and wasn't up to it; second of nine in a handicap at Chester (7.7f, good to soft) in June, but has enough to prove after a modest AW debut at Wolverhampton (7f, Tapeta) last month.
runners.comment: Highly tried after his winning debut; enough to prove after a modest AW debut last month

runners.name: Malachy's Wish
runners.spotlight: Landed a Ffos Las maiden (7.4f, heavy) and a Newcastle novice (7f, Tapeta) last September; well held in handicaps in his last two starts including on his reappearance at Sandown (7f, good; first start since being gelded) in June; needs to rebound.
runners.comment: Well held in handicaps in last two starts including on his reappearance; needs to rebound

runners.name: Souffler
runners.spotlight: Improved on her first two starts when winning a Newmarket novice (7f, good) last October (race has produced winners); market informative now making her handicap debut after ten months off.
runners.comment: Won a Newmarket novice last October; market useful on handicap debut after ten months off

runners.name: King David

runners.comment: Just 1-25, but return to this trip should help and he drops into a 0-55 for the first time

runners.name: Jackson Street
runners.spotlight: Has a modest 2-39 strike-rate, but his latest win came over C&D in December and he is back off the same mark; worth a second look.
runners.comment: Latest win came over C&D in December and he is back off the same mark; worth a second look

runners.name: Gal

runners.comment: Won at Leicester last time; runner-up is 2-2 since, but this is a much sharper track

runners.name: Ashford Hill
runners.spotlight: Both wins have come over C&D and is back off the same mark as for her successful reappearance here in January; out of her depth last time, but one to be interested in back at this level.
runners.comment: Both wins have come over C&D and is back off the same mark as for the latest of those

runners.name: Distillation
runners.spotlight: Made all and just held on at Wolverhampton (7f, Tapeta) last month, but the longer trip seemed to find him out at Southwell (1m, Tapeta) five days ago; return to 7f a positive and respected.
runners.comment: Made all over 7f at Wolverhampton last month, but didn't stay 1m next time; respected

runners.name: Twitch

runners.comment: Off the same mark as when beaten a neck over C&D in April, but losing run is up to 18

runners.name: Material Girl

runners.comment: Fifth in a 0-50 classified event at Newcastle 11 days ago; this is tougher; cheekpieces on

runners.name: Aplaceinthesun
runners.spotlight: Six runs for four different stables, but made an encouraging debut for this one when beaten less than 2l into fourth of nine at Ffos Las (6f, good) a fortnight ago; shaped than as though the return to this trip might suit; one for the shortlist.
runners.comment: Shaped as though a return to 7f would suit when fourth on stable debut a fortnight ago

runners.name: Yes Waliim
runners.spotlight: 0-8 and the step up in trip made no difference at Wolverhampton (8.6f, Tapeta) 11 days ago; this intermediate distance may suit him better, but improvement is required; hood removed after one use.
runners.comment: 0-8; this intermediate distance may suit him better, but improvement is required

runners.name: Prince Ali
runners.spotlight: First and second in his last two starts on varying ground at Chepstow (1m) under regular rider Zoe Lewis, but there has to be a doubt over the suitability of a fast 7f like this back on the AW.
runners.comment: First and second in last two starts but doubts over the suitability of a fast 7f like this

runners.name: African Spirit
runners.spotlight: Winless since his successful 2yo debut, but running better of late as when third of 12 from a wide draw at Wolverhampton (7f, Tapeta) 12 days ago (winner has gone in again since); shortlisted.
runners.comment: Winless since his successful 2yo debut, but running better of late; shortlisted

runners.comment: In good form, runner-up at Redcar latest; bold showing is on cards off an unchanged mark

runners.name: Jewel Maker
runners.spotlight: Veteran who is a dual winner (including over C&D) here but his recent form is not so encouraging, just seventh of 13 in 1m2f Newcastle handicap 17 days ago; needs to get back on track.
runners.comment: A dual winner (including over C&D) here but his recent form is not so encouraging

runners.name: Hostility
runners.spotlight: Gained a belated first success over C&D in June but he's not the most reliable and came in only fifth of eight in 1m1f handicap here following month; not out of things if back on his A-game though.
runners.comment: C&D winner in June; only fifth here following month; not out of things if on his A-game

runners.name: Perfidia

runners.comment: Non-staying seventh at Beverley two weeks ago; very much one to consider back in trip

runners.name: Balance Of Trade
runners.spotlight: Fair ex-Irish maiden; well held over hurdles at Killarney on final run for Paul Mulligan 25 days ago; needs this yard switch to spark a resurgence.
runners.comment: Ex-Irish maiden; well held over hurdles latest; needs yard switch to spark a resurgence

runners.name: Bay Dream Believer
runners.spotlight: Bagged a second success of the summer in 1m handicap at Nottingham 24 days ago by neck from Perfidia; more is needed from a 4lb higher mark here though.
runners.comment: Bagged handicap at Nottingham latest; more is needed from a 4lb higher mark here though

runners.name: Rajawail
runners.spotlight: Record of 0-27 and she failed to beat a rival in 1m2f Beverley handicap in June; she's hard to make a case for.
runners.comment: 0-27 and she failed to beat a rival in 1m2f Beverley handicap in June

runners.name: Izzari

runners.comment: A dual 1m/1m2f winner in 2025 but largely below par this term though; others appeal more

runners.comment: Big step forward when short-head second over C&D last month; looks the one to beat here

runners.owner: Teme Valley, Aura Racing & T Jacobs

runners.comment: Last of six in maiden at Pontefract on her debut; clearly thought capable of better

runners.comment: Runner-up in 5f Beverley maiden 22 days ago; likely player once more on her nursery debut

runners.comment: Very good second at Chester in May but she has failed to build on it in three runs since

runners.name: Lauralynn

runners.comment: Third in 5f maidens at Hamilton and Pontefract; may do better with blinkers added

runners.name: Jenever

runners.comment: Close third at Nottingham three weeks ago and remains well handicapped

runners.name: Another Investment
runners.spotlight: Runner-up three consecutive times since returning from short break in June, losing out only by a nose over C&D (good) on second occasion; creeping up the weights but ought to be right in the thick of things again.
runners.comment: Second on last three appearances, losing out only by a nose over C&D two starts ago

runners.name: Pickersgill
runners.spotlight: Runner-up twice on Tapeta at Southwell (7f/6f) last month and her defeat there on Thursday is probably best overlooked (fractious in stalls and slowly away) but she returns to turf on a fairly tough mark.
runners.comment: Second twice on AW at Southwell last month but returns to turf on fairly tough mark

runners.name: Sixtygeesbaby
runners.spotlight: Seemingly aided by first-time visor when fifth of 19 at York (6f, good to firm) last month but failed to build on that performance when favourite at Nottingham three weeks ago and is now 0-7 for David O'Meara.
runners.comment: Ran well in new visor at York last month but shade disappointed when favourite since

runners.name: Maldevious
runners.spotlight: Opened account at 13th attempt, with pushed-out success in first-time tongue-tie at Thirsk (6f, good) ten days ago; went up 7lb for that but the form was boosted when the reopposing third Great won on Wednesday.
runners.comment: Came good with clearcut win in first-time tongue-tie ten days ago; up 7lb; still respected

races.race_name: Ladies Night 2027 On Sale Now Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Savrola
runners.spotlight: A two-time scorer (at up to 2m) in 2025; yet to hit top form in a trio of runs this season, fifteenth in 2m handicap at Newcastle in June; more is needed after a break.
runners.comment: A two-time scorer (at up to 2m) in 2025; yet to hit top form in a trio of runs this season

runners.name: Asia Force
runners.spotlight: Son of Frankel who has shown fair form when in the frame on all his five runs this season, recording a creditable fourth of five in 1m4f Thirsk handicap last month; since gelded and needs considering stepping up in trip.
runners.comment: Creditable fourth at Thirsk last month; since gelded and needs considering up in trip

runners.name: Ludo's Landing
runners.spotlight: Scored at Newcastle (1m4f) in March but largely below form since, last of four in 1m4f handicap at Thirsk ten days ago; this course winner needs to take a step forward in refitted blinkers.
runners.comment: Scored at Newcastle in March but largely below form since; needs to take a step forward

runners.name: Shipshape
runners.spotlight: Thriving for his new stable and gained a third success in 1m4f Chester handicap in June; backed that up with a good second of seven in 2m handicap there since; big player off the same mark here.
runners.comment: Third win of 2026 at Chester in June; good Chester second latest; big player off same mark

runners.name: Gibside
runners.spotlight: Course winner but he's yet to hit top form this season and came in a never-dangerous third of five in 1m6f handicap at Thirsk 18 days ago; not easy to make a case for despite a falling mark.
runners.comment: Course winner but he's yet to hit top form this season; not easy to make a case for

runners.name: Talismans Time
runners.spotlight: Dual 1m3f/1m5f winner at Hamilton last summer; lightly raced since but back on track of late and posted a solid fifth of 13 in 2m York handicap 18 days ago; enters calculations eased 1lb.
runners.comment: Solid fifth of 13 in 2m York handicap 18 days ago; enters calculations eased 1lb

runners.name: Dance Time
runners.spotlight: A three-time AW scorer (at up to 1m6f) in 2025; largely in good form this season and recorded a solid third of 11 over C&D in June; not out of things after a break.
runners.comment: Solid third of 11 over C&D in June; not out of things after a break

runners.name: Ouro Preto
runners.spotlight: A fair 1m4f scorer in France in 2025; has failed to show that form for his current yard and came in only eighth of ten in 1m5f handicap at Hamilton ten days ago; others are preferred.
runners.comment: A fair 1m4f scorer in France in 2025 but has failed to show that form for his current yard

races.race_name: Racing Again Wednesday 19th August Handicap

runners.name: Only Dream Big
runners.spotlight: Struck form with consecutive wins in June (7f/1m, good); not quite at same level on any of her three outings last month but will appreciate this dip back into Class 6 and her current mark ought to be workable.
runners.comment: Won twice in June (7f/1m); form dipped slightly last month but she's back in Class 6 today

runners.name: Viviana
runners.spotlight: Failed to build upon fairly encouraging handicap debut when well-held fourth at Beverley (7.4f, good to firm) last month but that was an odd tactical race and, after only five runs, she may still have more to offer.
runners.comment: Well held when fourth at Beverley last month but still has time to do better

runners.name: Sparkling Pink
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who has made the frame three times over 7f/1m this season; gave it a fairly good shot before fading into seventh at Doncaster (7f, good to firm; first-time cheekpieces) ten days ago and continues to edge down the weights; one to consider.
runners.comment: Front-runner; gave decent account at Doncaster recently and is edging down the weights

runners.name: Truly Special
runners.spotlight: Opened account at ninth attempt, gamely making all over nearly 6f here (soft) two months ago; should also be suited by today's trip-and-ground combination but her overall profile remains unconvincing.
runners.comment: Gamely made all here (nearly 6f, soft) in June but overall profile remains unconvincing

runners.name: Oasis Cover
runners.spotlight: Signed off for Edward Bethell with pretty good second at Redcar (6f, good) in June but was soundly beaten over that trip on both starts for new stable last month and needs to bounce back over this longer distance.
runners.comment: Runner-up over 6f in June but soundly beaten on both starts for new stable last month

runners.name: Yoko
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden; not beaten that far when fifth of eight on seasonal/stable debut at Chester (7f, good) last month but struggled to get competitive at Wolverhampton (7f, AW; first-time hood) recently and arrives here with a point to prove.
runners.comment: Not disgraced on last month's seasonal/stable debut but well beaten since

runners.name: Leelawadee
runners.spotlight: Close second of four behind odds-on favourite on handicap debut at Thirsk (1m, good to firm; front pair well clear) last month; went up 2lb for that but remains unexposed and has strong claims if coping with this drop back in trip.
runners.comment: Close second of four on recent handicap debut; drops back from 1m; good chance

runners.name: Douwantitrightnow
runners.spotlight: Last of ten when 66-1 over C&D (good) in June and has now been unplaced all six starts; big leap of faith required to support her.
runners.comment: Last of ten when 66-1 over C&D in June and has now been unplaced all six starts

runners.name: Storm Esme
runners.spotlight: Dual 6f 2yo winner from just three starts but out of form this season (five runs; 5f-8.3f); needs first-time cheekpieces to prompt a revival.
runners.comment: Dual 6f 2yo winner from just three starts but out of form this season; cheekpieces added

races.race_name: Hamilton Park "Hands And Heels" Apprentice Handicap (Part Of The Racing Excellence Series)

runners.name: South Shore Island
runners.spotlight: 27-race maiden but he went close to getting off the mark when beaten a neck at Redcar (6f, good to firm) 13 days ago; drops back in trip with solid place claims.
runners.comment: 0-27 but went close over 6f at Redcar 13 days ago; back in trip with place claims

runners.name: Cotai Starlight
runners.spotlight: Off the mark when winning at Ayr (6f, good to firm) on her second try in handicap company before another solid run there two weeks ago; claims if handling this drop in trip.
runners.comment: Off the mark at Ayr on her second try in a handicap before another solid effort latest

runners.name: Hurt You Never
runners.spotlight: Four-time course winner, most recently off a 15lb higher mark last August; has mostly struggled since but she was sparked up by first-time blinkers when beaten a neck at Nottingham (5f, good to firm) eight days ago; has to be respected off the same mark.
runners.comment: Four-time course winner who was sparked up by first-time blinkers at Nottingham last time

runners.name: Summerstorms Dream
runners.spotlight: 0-12 but she finished second of six at Ayr (6f, good to firm) last month; got going too late when sixth there over 5f on Saturday and may prefer an extra furlong.
runners.comment: 0-12 but runner-up at Ayr last month; got going too late there over 5f on Saturday

runners.name: Tanjen
runners.spotlight: Dual AW winner over 5f last year; hasn't been at her best this season but ran respectably when fifth of 11 at Chester (5f, good) 17 days ago and now drops in grade; respected.
runners.comment: Dual AW winner last year; ran respectably at Chester last time and now drops in grade

runners.name: Ukiyo
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 17 starts came at Cork (6f, yielding) last September when trained by Gavin Cromwell but she was placed in competitive events last year; ran a solid race at Ayr (6f, good) three days ago and holds claims if backing that up.
runners.comment: 1-17; ran a solid race at Ayr three days ago and holds claims if backing that up

runners.name: Hvar
runners.spotlight: 6f novice winner at Wolverhampton last October on his final start for Ralph Beckett, but he's struggled in five starts since joining this stable; continues to fall in the weights but a wind operation needs to have made a difference.
runners.comment: 6f novice winner for Ralph Beckett but struggled in handicaps for this yard; wind surgery

runners.name: Never Dark
runners.spotlight: Without a success since September 2024 but that did come over this C&D off a 22lb higher mark; faded into seventh of 11 here ten days ago but it would be no surprise to see him go well.
runners.comment: 22lb below his last winning mark but faded into seventh of 11 here ten days ago

races.race_name: Kinrara Gin EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C And D) (EBF Restricted/Hamilton 2yo Qual') (GBB)

runners.name: Sea Mirage
runners.spotlight: Best effort from four runs came when second of ten at Leicester (5f, good to firm) in May on his second start; gelded prior to finishing behind Baldetti when fourth of seven at Pontefract (6f, good to firm) last month and better will be needed to reverse placings with that rival.
runners.comment: Best effort came at Leicester in May; behind Baldetti over 6f at Pontefract last time

runners.name: Baldetti
runners.spotlight: Shaped well when third on his debut at Leicester (5f, good to firm) in May and stepped forward from that effort when going close at Pontefract (6f, good to firm) last month; strong claims.
runners.comment: Stepped forward from his debut when going close at Pontefract last month; strong claims
runners.owner: G H Thompson And Michael Dods

runners.name: Harley
runners.spotlight: Placed in two of his first three starts in novice/maiden company and was gelded prior to finishing second of six in a handicap at Ripon (6f, good to firm); solid claims on his return to a novice.
runners.comment: Gelded prior to finishing second of six in a Ripon handicap last time; has solid claims

runners.name: Longshanks Luke
runners.spotlight: Has worn blinkers for both starts; took a big step forward from his debut outing when fourth of eight at Pontefract (6f, good to firm; beaten around 2l) six days ago; should be capable of better but that will be needed.
runners.comment: Took a big step forward from his debut when fourth of eight at Pontefract six days ago

runners.name: Profitability
runners.spotlight: Remote fifth of nine on her debut at Haydock (6f, good to soft) in May but did take a small step forward when sixth of 12 at Chester (6f, good) last month; probably one for handicaps.
runners.comment: Took a small step forward from her debut when sixth at Chester; likely one for handicaps
runners.owner: Peter Onslow & Mr & Mrs Gary Middlebrook

runners.name: Lightenings Legacy
runners.spotlight: Showed little on his debut at Kempton (7f, AW; 25-1) for Grace Harris in June; now drops to 6f and has a visor applied for his stable debut; best watched unless the market speaks in his favour.
runners.comment: Showed little on his debut at Kempton over 7f for Grace Harris; visor on for yard debut

races.race_name: David & William McHarg Memorial Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Sheikhnshah
runners.spotlight: Has finished third and run to a similar level in each of his three starts, most recently at Southwell (1m, AW) in June; has been gelded since and has the hood left off on this switch back to turf; he's well bred and could still have more to offer.
runners.comment: Has finished third in each of his three starts; gelded and has the hood left off

runners.name: Upper East
runners.spotlight: Posted an RPR of 80 when fourth of five (beaten 4l) on his debut at Doncaster (1m, good to firm) in June but was beaten 15l when last of six at Sandown (1m2f, good) next time; has since left Richard Hannon and makes his stable debut having been purchased for 12,000gns.
runners.comment: Posted an RPR of 80 on his debut but well beaten at Sandown since; makes his stable debut

runners.name: Matter Of Britain
runners.spotlight: 6l second of six behind an easy winner on his debut over this C&D last month; didn't really build on that when third of five at Nottingham (8.5f, good to firm) 12 days ago but still a contender.
runners.comment: Bumped into an easy winner here on his debut and ran to a similar level at Nottingham

runners.name: Al Fujairah
runners.spotlight: Stayed on into a modest fourth here over 1m1f on his debut and ran to a similar level when third of six over C&D last month; he looks likely to do better in handicaps over longer trips.
runners.comment: Ran to a similar level in two starts here; one for handicaps over longer trips

runners.name: Eagles Instinct
runners.spotlight: Gleneagles colt; eighth foal; half-brother to six winners including Eternal Sunshine (5f-6f; RPR 93), Sound Of Iona (prolific 5f-6f; 91), Oriental Lilly (prolific 5f-7f including AW; 89), Bonito Cavalo (5f-7f AW; 85) and Rory (5f-7f including AW; 75); dam 5f winner (including 2yo; 79); from a family his trainer knows well but he may need this debut experience.
runners.comment: Gleneagles colt; from a family his trainer knows well but may need this debut experience

runners.name: Midnight Serenade
runners.spotlight: Sent off a big price and showed little on her debut here over 1m3f ten days ago; drops in trip with the hood removed; best watched.
runners.comment: Showed little on her debut here over 1m3f ten days ago; drops in trip; hood removed

runners.name: Freddy Fearless
runners.spotlight: Never threatened when fourth of seven on his debut at Leicester (1m, good) in June and wasn't able to build on that when upped to 1m2f at Pontefract last month; likely one for handicaps.
runners.comment: Never threatened when fourth on debut (1m) and failed to build on that over 1m2f last time

runners.name: League Of Justice
runners.spotlight: Brother to US 1m2f AW winner Jitterbug; attracted some support before finishing midfield on his debut at Southwell (7f, AW; 13-2) last month; now steps up to 1m and switches to turf; open to improvement.
runners.comment: Finished midfield on his debut at Southwell over 7f; steps up to 1m; open to improvement

races.race_name: Kinrara Distillery Scottish Trophy Handicap

runners.name: Return To Unit
runners.spotlight: Won a maiden at Nottingham (8.5f, good) last October and doubled his tally when landing a handicap on soft ground over that same C&D in first-time blinkers two months ago; now 8lb higher but this lightly raced 4yo should still have more to offer; stable won this in 2022.
runners.comment: Won a soft-ground Nottingham handicap in first-time blinkers two months ago; 8lb higher

runners.name: Point Of Contact
runners.spotlight: Showed improved form when beating 15 rivals to land a 0-85 York handicap in June (1m1f, good) but he disappointed when favourite at Sandown (1m2f, good to firm) last month; may be capable of bouncing back.
runners.comment: Won a 16-runner handicap at York before a disappointing effort latest; bounce-back needed

runners.name: Spoken Truth
runners.spotlight: Sole win came at Cork (1m2f, soft) in April 2024 when trained by Dermot Weld but has posted some good efforts for this stable, including when fourth of 11 at Ascot (1m, good to firm) last month; now steps back up in trip with each-way claims.
runners.comment: 1-16 but has posted some good efforts for this yard, including at Ascot last time; solid

runners.name: Brigid's Well
runners.spotlight: Won a Thirsk novice over 1m last August; respectable tenth in the Sandringham in June before finishing sixth of ten at Ayr (1m, good) last month; still has stamina to prove for this trip.
runners.comment: Won a Thirsk novice over 1m last August; still has stamina to prove for this trip

runners.name: Altareq
runners.spotlight: Had been shaping well since joining this stable, including when third of five here over 8.5f in June, prior to getting off the mark  at Ayr (1m2f, good) two starts ago; can have a line put through his latest effort in the John Smith's Cup having encountered trouble against the rail; makes the shortlist.
runners.comment: Off the mark when winning at Ayr two starts ago; latest run can be ignored; shortlisted

runners.name: Swift Salian
runners.spotlight: Three wins from 27 starts include one here over 8.5f last May; has finished second in each of his three starts this season (good to soft/soft) but has a bit to do to reverse placings with Return To Unit from their meeting at Nottingham (8.5f, soft) two months ago.
runners.comment: C&D winner but has a bit to do to reverse Nottingham placings with Return To Unit

runners.name: Cadarn
runners.spotlight: Returned to form to make all at York (1m, good) in June and backed that up with another good effort at Ripon (1m, good) 24 days ago, finishing a close-up third of seven; runs off the same mark today and could go well over this slightly longer trip.
runners.comment: Made all at York in June and backed it up with another good effort at Ripon; could go well

runners.name: Blue To Blue
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner for Karl Burke (5f/7f); ran well at Haydock (1m, good) on his stable debut in May but he was below that level on his next two starts, and was safely held when third of four at Redcar (1m2f, good to firm) last month.
runners.comment: Three-time winner for previous yard; ran well on stable debut in May; safely held latest

runners.name: Strength Of Spirit
runners.spotlight: Made a winning reappearance at Musselburgh (1m, good to soft; first start since being gelded) in April and he also went close there over 1m1f in June; down the field at Goodwood (1m2f, good to firm) 12 days ago having raced freely, but it's likely this slight drop back in trip will suit.
runners.comment: Down the field over 1m2f at Goodwood 12 days ago but should be more suited by this trip
runners.owner: Hambleton Racing Ltd XXXV & E Burke

runners.name: Impartiality
runners.spotlight: Winner of his first three starts in 2025, including here over 8.5f (good), and also went close on heavy ground at Goodwood (1m; first-time cheekpieces) last July; below his best on his first two starts this year but bounced back when runner-up at Chester (1m2f, good to soft) in June; contender.
runners.comment: Course winner; runner-up at Chester last time on his first try over 1m2f; contender

runners.name: Double Parked
runners.spotlight: Bounced back from a lesser effort when narrowly beaten in a first-time tongue-tie at Redcar (1m, good) in June before winning at York (1m2f, good) next time; won't mind this drop back in trip and holds claims off this 4lb higher mark.
runners.comment: Went close at Redcar before winning over 1m2f at York last time; claims off 4lb higher

runners.name: Galyx
runners.spotlight: Dual winner in 2024 (1m/1m2f; soft/heavy), the most recent coming in a handicap at Leicester off the same mark as today's; stepped forward from his reappearance when fourth of 14 at Sandown (1m2f, good) two months ago but has been off since; any rain would be welcomed.
runners.comment: Both wins on soft/heavy going; stepped forward from return when fourth at Sandown in June

runners.name: Dwindling Funds
runners.spotlight: Six wins last season included one over C&D; went close at Musselburgh (1m1f, good) in June and Ayr (1m, good) last month, before landing a 0-80 at York (1m, good to firm) 17 days ago; steps back up in grade but can't be discounted.
runners.comment: C&D winner last year; went close in two starts before winning a 0-80 at York last time
runners.owner: D P Van Der Hoeven & D G Pryde

races.race_name: Follow Us On X @hamiltonparkrc Handicap

runners.name: Epidavros
runners.spotlight: Plenty of defeats at short prices since her last victory, here almost two years ago; she's more than capable off this mark, though, if the first-time headgear does the trick in a winnable handicap.
runners.comment: More than capable off this mark if the headgear does the trick in a winnable handicap

runners.name: Vitality
runners.spotlight: Has gone completely the wrong way, often from the front, mainly because of a tendency to pull hard; a lot will hinge on how things pan out early from stall 1 and how she settles in the first-time hood; risks involved either way.
runners.comment: Gone the wrong way, mainly because of a tendency to pull hard; much hinges on the new hood
runners.owner: Miss D Finkler, A Herd, Dr P Holloway 1

runners.name: Quiet Resolve
runners.spotlight: Patchy for Richard Fahey last year and has reverted to type for his new yard this time, having kicked off with a C&D win off 2lb lower in May; does like it here though, and this a bit easier, having been said to have hung right at Chester last time.
runners.comment: Likes it here; this a bit easier, having been said to have hung right at Chester last time

runners.name: Turtle Reef
runners.spotlight: Pulled too hard in two 1m2f handicaps earlier in the summer; hopefully the gelding operation and drop in trip will see him settle, in which case he ought to fare better for a yard with a decent record with 3yos here.
runners.comment: Hopefully the gelding operation and drop in trip will see him settle; can do better if so

runners.name: Sanafi Zabeel
runners.spotlight: Usually makes the running but wasn't able to from stall 13 over 7f at Ayr on Saturday, an effort that confirmed him still in good form; only 1lb higher than when winning over C&D in May and is on the shortlist.
runners.comment: Solid run at the weekend; only 1lb higher than when winning over C&D in May; player

runners.name: Sogniamo
runners.spotlight: Left last year's debut behind when springing an 80-1 surprise over 9.2f here on her comeback in the spring; since disappointing in two handicaps and, while it's still early days, it's hard to be confident.
runners.comment: Disappointing in two handicaps and, while it's still early days, it's hard to be confident

runners.name: Pink Azalea
runners.spotlight: Three soft-ground wins last summer, going 24lb up the weights in the process, before finishing the season with a whimper; three more poor runs this season leave her hard to recommend, although it's possible the warm summer will have helped.
runners.comment: Three poor runs this year leave her hard to fancy, though the warm summer may have helped

runners.name: Toralou
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent mare who's been withdrawn on account of good to firm ground since disappointing on fast going early last month; holds claims on her previous Ffos Las second to a subsequent winner but only has a maiden win to her name.
runners.comment: Inconsistent mare; good to firm ground not ideal latest but only a maiden win to her name

runners.name: Real Trouper
runners.spotlight: Some promise on his York debut last spring but well below that level in two runs on Tapeta this summer (out of a Wolverhampton winner); interesting to see how he goes in the market now handicapping.
runners.comment: Well held in two runs on Tapeta this summer; interesting to see how he goes in the market
runners.owner: Peter Onslow, FDC Holdings Ltd & NWIR Ltd

runners.name: Second Fiddle
runners.spotlight: Unlucky behind a subsequent winner last month and gave her running once more latest, both in small-field C&D affairs that weren't run to suit; the return to a bigger field should help and she has every chance, despite a 3lb higher mark.
runners.comment: Return to a bigger field should help and she has every chance, despite a 3lb higher mark

races.race_name: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap

runners.name: Top Juggler
runners.spotlight: Won a C&D maiden in 2024; ran well here on his first two starts this year and won a handicap by a neck at Chester (5.5f, good) last month; form figures at this track read 14232 and he makes the shortlist.
runners.comment: Won at Chester last time; course form figures read 14232; makes the shortlist

runners.name: Not Me
runners.spotlight: Off the mark when winning on his stable debut at Chester (7.5f, soft) in June before finishing behind Iris Dancer here next time; below his best on the AW two weeks ago and cheekpieces are now reached for.
runners.comment: Made a winning stable debut in June; below his best on the AW latest; cheekpieces added

runners.name: Territorial Knight
runners.spotlight: Dual winner over 6f (good/good to soft), the most recent coming at Doncaster last summer off a 3lb lower mark; fifth in the Ayr Bronze Cup in September (soft) and he ran well when second of 17 there last month; has to be respected.
runners.comment: 3lb above his last winning mark; ran well when second of 17 at Ayr last month; respected

runners.name: Iris Dancer
runners.spotlight: Course specialist having won over this C&D 12 times, most recently last month off a 1lb lower mark than today's; below her best when dropped back to 5f here ten days ago but she's the type to bounce back on her return to this trip.
runners.comment: Has won over C&D 12 times; below her best here over 5f latest but the type to bounce back

runners.name: Station X
runners.spotlight: Front-runner whose three turf wins have all been on ground slower than good, the most recent coming when holding on at Chester (6f, good to soft) two months ago; may not have things all his own way in front but commands respect off this 2lb higher mark.
runners.comment: Front-runner; made all at Chester two months ago; commands respect off a 2lb higher mark

runners.name: Novamay
runners.spotlight: Gained her fourth success when winning at 14-runner handicap at Ayr (6f, soft; Parisiac was second) in June but she was well beaten off this mark at Newmarket (good to firm) last month; needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: Won on soft ground at Ayr in June but well beaten off this mark at Newmarket last time

runners.name: U Sure Do
runners.spotlight: Tongue tied for the first time when showing a good attitude to win at Ripon (6f, good; flag start) in May when last seen; only 1lb higher and he can be competitive granted he's ready to go on his first outing for 95 days.
runners.comment: Tongue tied for the first time when winning at Ripon in May; off since and now 1lb higher

runners.name: Cargin Bhui
runners.spotlight: Three-time AW winner, the most recent coming at Southwell (6f) in February off a 7lb lower mark; shaped as if still in form when fifth of ten at Musselburgh (7f, good) in April but he's been off since; could go well with the likely strong gallop suiting him.
runners.comment: Triple AW winner; off since April but could go well if they go a strong gallop

runners.name: Dandy Magic
runners.spotlight: Sole win on turf came at Ayr (5f, good to soft) last September; has ran to a similar level on her last four outings, most recently when third of nine at Ascot (5f, good to firm; first-time cheekpieces) 18 days ago; stepping back up in trip will suit and she's considered.
runners.comment: Has ran to a similar level on her last four outings; stepping back up in trip will suit

runners.name: Trilby
runners.spotlight: Has won twice this year (both when ridden by P J McDonald), at Haydock (5f, soft) in May and Carlisle (5f, good to soft) in June; well beaten at York (6f, good to firm) last time, but that was a 0-105 and he wasn't best drawn; drops back down in grade and should have this run to suit.
runners.comment: Won at Haydock in May and Carlisle in June; well held in a 0-105 at York last time

runners.name: Parisiac
runners.spotlight: Made all over C&D in June before good runner-up efforts behind Trilby and Novamay on his next two starts; however, he was below his best at Ayr last time and will likely face competition for the lead.
runners.comment: Made all over C&D in June but he will like face competition for the lead this time

runners.name: Bergerac
runners.spotlight: Course winner last June off a 10lb higher mark than today's, but he's been struggling in recent starts and hasn't won over 6f since August 2022; best watched at present.
runners.comment: 10lb below his win here over 5f last June but he's struggled in recent starts

runners.name: Milford
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 18 starts came on his debut in a 5f maiden on soft ground in May 2024 but he has posted some good efforts since; midfield finishes in three starts this year, including when drawn wide at York over 7f on his last two outings; drops back in trip and down in grade with the visor returning.
runners.comment: Drawn wide at York over 7f on his last two outings; drops in grade; visor back on

runners.name: Never Just A Dream
runners.spotlight: All four wins have been on the AW; ran an encouraging race when fourth of eight on his stable debut at Newbury (6f, good to soft) in June but he wasn't able to build on that when dropped back to 5f at Newmarket (good to firm) last month; back up in trip.
runners.comment: Ran an encouraging race on his stable debut but couldn't build on that at Newmarket (5f)

races.race_name: Book Your Christmas Party At Hamilton Park Handicap

runners.name: Ebony Maw
runners.spotlight: Has never run on ground faster than good and has a couple of heavy-ground wins to his name; 0-13 here but has gone close more than once and arrives in form, having responded well to a switch to front-running at Ayr last month; leading claims upped 2lb.
runners.comment: 0-13 here but has gone close more than once and arrives in form; leading claims upped 2lb

runners.name: Falaise Blanc
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent gelding who went close over C&D in early June and came back to that sort of level when behind Patrick Street three days ago (8lb better off back into a handicap); often pulls hard and it will depend on his mood.
runners.comment: Went close over C&D in June; better behind Patrick Street on Saturday; depends on his mood

runners.name: Fairydale
runners.spotlight: Started handicap life on an unrealistic mark but has found her level now, coming away with the favourite under a canny ride at Catterick a few weeks ago; that was the first time she'd made the running and she's considered upped a fair 2lb.
runners.comment: Started handicap life on an unrealistic mark but has found her level now; one to consider

runners.name: Patrick Street
runners.spotlight: Irish raider who won a 0-50 classified event over the weekend; this looks a bit more competitive under a 4lb penalty but the longer trip will suit, with him taking a while to get on top over 1m2f at Ayr; goes on the shortlist.
runners.comment: This a bit more competitive under a 4lb penalty but the longer trip will suit; shortlisted

runners.name: Satyress
runners.spotlight: Achieved little last season but much better in two runs this time, getting off the mark in a messy Beverley affair seven weeks ago off 2lb lower (unlucky runner-up has done little for the effort since); this looks stronger but she may yet have more to offer.
runners.comment: Achieved little last season but much better in two runs this time; may have more to offer

runners.name: Mr Withington
runners.spotlight: Best efforts have come at around 1m2f and he hasn't looked to see it out in a handful of starts over further, latterly in first-time cheekpieces (switches to blinkers tonight) at Musselburgh 11 days ago; on a competitive mark now otherwise.
runners.comment: Not looked to see it out in a handful of starts at beyond 1m2f; on a competitive mark now

runners.name: Spirit Of Nature
runners.spotlight: Related to some useful winners, mainly over shorter, but isn't up to much himself (1m-1m3f); huge price for his handicap debut recently, back from a second round of wind surgery, and ran no sort of race at Ayr yesterday (1m).
runners.comment: Undergone wind surgery twice and isn't up to much; ran no sort of race at Ayr yesterday

runners.name: Storm On Jura
runners.spotlight: Regressive maiden who again pulled hard when some way behind Patrick Street and Falaise Blanc at Ayr over the weekend; will need to settle much better coming back up from 1m2f.
runners.comment: Regressive maiden who again pulled hard behind two of these at the weekend; has to settle

runners.name: Game Management
runners.spotlight: Not a bad comeback from a lengthy absence at Ayr yesterday (1m), having been off since pulled up a couple of times over hurdles; maybe enough of an ask to go again so soon and this would be as far as he's been on the Flat.
runners.comment: Not a bad return from lengthy layoff at Ayr yesterday; never been this far on the Flat
runners.owner: Mrs C Clark D Pollitt & Mrs E Quinlan

races.race_name: Download The Oddschecker App Nursery Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Time For The Moon
runners.spotlight: Beaten-favourite on his debut before easily winning a weak-looking Musselburgh novice in early June; faced a couple of tough tasks in Listed company since and, while this is much easier, he now has to prove he isn't just going the wrong way; goes up in trip.
runners.comment: This is much easier but has to prove he isn't just going the wrong way; goes up in trip

runners.name: Apulia Bay
runners.spotlight: 600,000gns half-brother to a useful middle-distance performer in Nightime Dancer (Group 3-placed); built on a promising Polytrack debut when beaten on the nod last time and should have more to offer now upped in trip.
runners.comment: Half-brother to useful middle-distance performer; should have more to offer upped in trip

races.race_name: Bet Smarter With Oddschecker+ Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Blessed Voyager
runners.spotlight: Winners behind when making a successful debut (5.2f) in April; very short price under a penalty at Thirsk 18 days ago, having been gelded in early June, when second; hard to know what to make of that effort as yet but the front pair were well clear.
runners.comment: Very short price under a penalty when second at Thirsk 18 days ago; needs more again

runners.name: Jeyoush
runners.spotlight: $70,000 foal, $275,000 yearling who's the first offspring of a dirt winner (6f-7f) in the US; likely looking type, who's sporting a tongue-tie on debut, for a yard going great guns this summer with 2yos.
runners.comment: $275,000 yearling; likely looking type (tongue-tied on debut) for a yard flying with 2yos

runners.name: Baddaddan
runners.spotlight: 100,000gns yearling who holds a few sales race entries; started the bigger price of his trainer's pair when shaping nicely on his Newbury debut last month (clear runner-up won since) and is entitled to improve.
runners.comment: Shaped nicely on his debut last month (clear runner-up won since); entitled to improve

races.race_name: Get Best Odds With Oddschecker Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: Zooter
runners.spotlight: Expensive to follow since handicapping and is back on the Flat after one try over hurdles late last month (well held); having his first crack at beyond 1m2f and has stamina to prove (dam was best at around 1m).
runners.comment: Expensive to follow since handicapping; first crack at beyond 1m2f; has stamina to prove

runners.name: Free World
runners.spotlight: Well held in three runs in Dubai last winter and on his first three starts for this yard; came in for support ahead of his first crack at this trip last Tuesday, though, when easily winning a Catterick handicap from the front; well in under a penalty for that.
runners.comment: Easily won a Catterick handicap from the front last Tuesday; well in under a 5lb penalty

runners.name: Simiyann
runners.spotlight: Not as good this year and has looked to have no excuses in some ordinary handicaps of late; only 1lb lower than when well held over 1m6f here 12 days ago and Free World looks his trainer's best chance.
runners.comment: Not as good this year and has looked to have no excuses in some ordinary handicaps of late

runners.name: Joanna Hiffernan
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to useful stayer Alfred Boucher, a winner for the yard in May; shaped as though ready for this sort of trip when a well-held second on her handicap debut (1m4f) four weeks ago; lightly raced and remains open to further improvement.
runners.comment: Half-sister to useful stayer Alfred Boucher; remains open to improvement now upped in trip

runners.name: Hope Rising
runners.spotlight: Reluctant at the start on a few occasions over hurdles in recent times, refusing to jump away on one occasion; has been fine at the stalls in two runs back on the Flat, though, and like Free World is well treated under a penalty following an easy win last Tuesday.
runners.comment: Well treated under a penalty following an easy win from the front last Tuesday; player

runners.name: Assured
runners.spotlight: Regressive maiden (1m2f-2m1f) who's been beaten a long way in three runs this year for her current yard.
runners.comment: Regressive maiden; beaten a long way in three runs this year for her current yard

races.race_name: Oddschecker Free Bets Handicap

runners.name: Midnight Media
runners.spotlight: Beat two subsequent winners off 4lb lower on the AW early last month and built on that on her second turf start last time, when coming home nicely for second in a race that didn't pan out her way; high on the shortlist.
runners.comment: Came home nicely in a race that didn't pan out her way last time; high on the shortlist

runners.name: Bradbury
runners.spotlight: Got it together since the eyeshield went on and wasn't best suited by the drop to 1m last time, when ducking right leaving the stalls; hasn't always looked the easiest but this mark feels within range for a stable in good form lately.
runners.comment: Got it together in the eyeshield; this mark feels within range for a stable in good form

runners.name: Beauty Generation
runners.spotlight: Winner over C&D early last month off a 3lb lower mark (second and fourth successful since); maybe wasn't best suited by the drop to 1m1f behind Katalyst here last time, when hanging right (not for the first time) having looked set to win; holds fair claims.
runners.comment: Winner over C&D early last month off a 3lb lower mark; holds fair claims upped from 1m1f

runners.name: Katalyst
runners.spotlight: Maiden who hasn't always looked straightforward; similar claims to Beauty Generation on 1m1f running here recently but since had no excuses from the front on her first crack at this trip at Windsor; Midnight Media looks her stable's number one.
runners.comment: Maiden who hasn't always looked straightforward; Midnight Media her stable's number one

runners.name: The Anthony Gover
runners.spotlight: Goes beyond an extended 1m for the first time (dam did her winning at around this distance) having met plenty of traffic off this mark a month ago; much will depend on the new trip switched from blinkers to cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Hit traffic latest; much will depend on the new trip switched from blinkers to cheekpieces

runners.name: Tommo's Ginjaninja
runners.spotlight: Mixed bag on turf since handicapping, over various distances, and the visor experiment has quickly been shelved; well worth a look in the market down another 2lb but others have more pressing claims.
runners.comment: Well worth a look in the market down another 2lb but others have more pressing claims

runners.name: Daretobedifferent
runners.spotlight: Spent last year sprinting and is having a first try over this far (won over 8.3f here in the spring off 3lb lower); didn't get going until too late in a small field last time (1m) but stamina would be the concern.
runners.comment: Spent last year sprinting and is having a first try over this far; stamina the concern

runners.name: Diane Chasseresse
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to stayer Alfred Boucher and Joanna Hiffernan (due to run over 2m in the previous race); shown enough in three runs to suggest she's worth keeping an eye on now upped from 1m, but it wouldn't surprise were a stiffer test to suit in due course.
runners.comment: Worth keeping an eye on upped from 1m but it wouldn't surprise were a stiffer test to suit

races.race_name: Oddschecker+ Subscription Service Handicap

runners.name: Moulin Booj
runners.spotlight: Ultra-consistent and arrives following a solid effort at Thirsk (same mark as tonight; his last winning rating); boasts a good record at this time of year and this is less competitive, so his claims are obvious.
runners.comment: Good record at this time of year and this is less competitive, so his claims are obvious

runners.name: Goyard
runners.spotlight: Decent comeback effort off a 3lb higher mark in June but has struggled twice since, losing his unbeaten Ripon record as favourite before finishing a remote last of four latest; something to prove now.
runners.comment: Struggled twice since a decent comeback effort off 3lb higher; something to prove now

runners.name: Mesaafi
runners.spotlight: In good form at Windsor early in the summer but a couple of below-par efforts since, including back there; wants a proper test over an easy 5f and will need to bounce back to his best off this mark.
runners.comment: Wants a proper test over an easy 5f and will need to bounce back to his best off this mark

runners.name: Grandlad
runners.spotlight: Made all when winning off this mark on his comeback over C&D in the spring; bounced back from a poor one at Newmarket (doesn't seem to like it there) when not beaten far last time and there's no obvious reason he won't go well again.
runners.comment: Made all over C&D in the spring; not beaten far last time and looks set to go well again

runners.name: Forager
runners.spotlight: Dual winner early last season who confirmed her liking for an easy 5f when going in again at Lingfield (AW) last October; off since an ordinary comeback in the spring and may need some help from the handicapper (4lb above her last successful mark).
runners.comment: Off since an ordinary comeback in the spring and may need some help from the handicapper

runners.name: Jax Edge
runners.spotlight: Prolific winner but never off a mark this high (Bath victory in early summer came off 5lb lower) and she's not still improving at her age; an easy 6f or stiffer 5f is optimal and she'll need to bounce back from a couple of lesser efforts.
runners.comment: Prolific winner but never off a mark this high; has to bounce back from two lesser efforts

runners.name: Michaela's Boy
runners.spotlight: Always tended to be hot and cold in the past, so disappointing he didn't fare better at Lingfield (AW) latest given a decent record there; not a lot of wiggle room off this mark and is now tried in first-time cheekpieces (wore blinkers twice as a 2yo).
runners.comment: Patchy; not a lot of wiggle room off this mark and is now tried in first-time cheekpieces

races.race_name: Oddschecker Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Melissa Honey
runners.spotlight: Enjoyed a good summer at a lower level but a slow start did for her when odds-on in a small field a fortnight ago; clearly well suited by a stiff 6f and this will be a different test against a better class of opponent.
runners.comment: Well suited by a stiff 6f; this a different test against a better class of opponent

runners.name: Sugar Sugar
runners.spotlight: Doesn't appeal as the easiest, often pulling hard and hanging left, but she's progressed, latterly when making a successful handicap debut off 2lb lower at Epsom 12 days ago; perhaps tonight's flatter track will help and it's still early days with her.
runners.comment: Progressed despite pulling hard and hanging left; maybe tonight's flatter track will help

runners.name: Seeing Stars
runners.spotlight: Kempton winner in the winter who's been expensive to follow otherwise, getting turned over at 3-1 or shorter five times; latest effort, her first in a sprint, was too bad to be true, but first-time headgear is now applied.
runners.comment: Expensive to follow; first-time headgear is applied following a poor one last time

runners.name: Thunderous Love
runners.spotlight: Won five times last season, including two over C&D, latterly off an 8lb higher mark; much her best effort of the year at Salisbury last time, off the same mark behind a subsequent winner, and is shortlisted back here for the first time in a while.
runners.comment: Best effort of the year at Salisbury last time; dual C&D winner; high on the shortlist

runners.name: Come On Eibhlin
runners.spotlight: Often highly tried last year; generally consistent in handicaps this season, off a sliding mark, but finding the right trip seems to be an issue, with her going up from 1m to 1m2f last time, and now dropping to 6f; blinkers are given a second try.
runners.comment: Finding the right trip seems to be an issue this year and blinkers are given a second try
runners.owner: Hold My Beer, Gee Gees Racing & N Clark

runners.name: Sweet Desire
runners.spotlight: Pulled hard and didn't see out 7f from the front last time, but she's now finished well held at big prices all three runs; needs a good forward step now handicapping.
runners.comment: Well held at big prices all three runs; needs a good forward step now handicapping
